nodes.name: Set Topic
nodes.notes: Change this value to any science topic you want to narrate (e.g. 'black holes', 'quantum entanglement', 'dark matter').

nodes.name: Stage 1: Fetch Paper
nodes.notes:
Searches ArXiv (then NASA RSS as fallback) for a non-duplicate paper matching the topic.

Outputs: { paper: {...}, run_id: '...' }

nodes.name: Stage 2: Generate Script
Stage 3: Generate Voice
nodes.notes:
Synthesises narration MP3 using gTTS or OpenAI TTS-1-HD.

Voice Profile env vars (all optional — defaults shown):
  VOICE_PROVIDER=gtts        (gtts | openai)
  VOICE_LOCALE=en-US         (BCP-47 language tag)
  VOICE_SPEED=1.0            (0.5–2.0; gTTS ignores)
  VOICE_PITCH=default        (default | low | high)
  VOICE_ID=                  (OpenAI voice name e.g. nova, alloy, echo)

If VOICE_PROVIDER=openai, OPENAI_API_KEY is also required.
Outputs: { audio: {...}, run_id: '...' }

nodes.name: Stage 4: Generate Images

parameters.command: cd /app && python python/generate_images.py --script '{{ $node["Stage 2: Generate Script"].json.stdout }}' --run-id '{{ $node["Stage 2: Generate Script"].json.stdout | fromJSON | getAttribute: "run_id" }}'

nodes.name: Stage 5: Render Video

parameters.command: cd /app && python python/render_video.py --script '{{ $node["Stage 2: Generate Script"].json.stdout }}' --audio '{{ $node["Stage 3: Generate Voice"].json.stdout }}' --images '{{ $node["Stage 4: Generate Images"].json.stdout }}' --run-id '{{ $node["Stage 3: Generate Voice"].json.stdout | fromJSON | getAttribute: "run_id" }}'

nodes.notes:
MoviePy compositing: images + audio + word-level subtitles + arXiv watermark.

Exports both:
  - video_horizontal.mp4 (1920x1080, 16:9)
  - video_vertical.mp4   (1080x1920, 9:16)

Outputs: { videos: [...], run_id: '...' }

nodes.name: Stage 6: Validate Manifest

parameters.command: cd /app && python python/validate_manifest.py --audio '{{ $node["Stage 3: Generate Voice"].json.stdout }}' --images '{{ $node["Stage 4: Generate Images"].json.stdout }}' --videos '{{ $node["Stage 5: Render Video"].json.stdout }}' --run-id '{{ $node["Stage 3: Generate Voice"].json.stdout | fromJSON | getAttribute: "run_id" }}'

nodes.notes:
Compliance gate: validates all asset licences against approved list.
Writes assets-manifest.json to output/<run_id>/.
Registers paper ID in data/processed_papers.json (prevents duplicate processing).

Exits 1 if any asset has an unapproved licence or verified=false.
Outputs: { manifest: {...}, manifest_path: '...', run_id: '...' }

nodes.name: Move to Output

parameters.command: RUN_ID='{{ $json.stdout | fromJSON | getAttribute: "run_id" }}' && mkdir -p /app/output/${RUN_ID} && mv /tmp/science_narrator/${RUN_ID}/video_horizontal.mp4 /app/output/${RUN_ID}/ && mv /tmp/science_narrator/${RUN_ID}/video_vertical.mp4 /app/output/${RUN_ID}/ && cp /app/output/${RUN_ID}/assets-manifest.json /app/output/${RUN_ID}/assets-manifest.json 2>/dev/null || true && echo "{\"output_dir\": \"/app/output/${RUN_ID}\", \"run_id\": \"${RUN_ID}\"}"

nodes.notes:
Moves completed video files from /tmp/science_narrator/<run_id>/ to /app/output/<run_id>/.
Outputs: { output_dir: '...', run_id: '...' }

nodes.name: Upload YouTube (16:9)

parameters.name: snippet.title
parameters.value: Science Video: {{ $node["Stage 2: Generate Script"].json.stdout | fromJSON | getAttribute: "script" | getAttribute: "learning_objective" }}

parameters.name: snippet.description

nodes.notes:
SETUP REQUIRED:
1. Create a YouTube OAuth2 credential in n8n (Settings → Credentials)
2. Attach it to this node
3. Change privacyStatus to 'public' or 'unlisted' when ready

Uploads the 16:9 horizontal video to YouTube.

nodes.name: Upload Facebook (9:16)

parameters.name: title
parameters.value: Science Video: {{ $node["Stage 2: Generate Script"].json.stdout | fromJSON | getAttribute: "script" | getAttribute: "learning_objective" }}

parameters.name: description
parameters.value: Source: {{ $node["Stage 2: Generate Script"].json.stdout | fromJSON | getAttribute: "script" | getAttribute: "paper_id" }}

nodes.notes:
SETUP REQUIRED:
1. Create a Facebook Graph API credential in n8n (Settings → Credentials)
2. Attach it to this node
3. Ensure your Facebook App has video_manage permission

Uploads the 9:16 vertical video to Facebook.

nodes.name: Error: Cleanup

parameters.command: cd /app && RUN_ID='{{ $json.run_id || "unknown" }}' && python python/lib/run_logger.py 2>/dev/null || true && python python/lib/cleanup.py --run-id "${RUN_ID}" && echo "{\"cleaned\": true, \"run_id\": \"${RUN_ID}\"}"

nodes.notes:
Triggered on any stage failure.
Runs cleanup.py to remove /tmp/science_narrator/<run_id>/ temp files.
Logs the failure to logs/<run_id>.json.
